bio.text: Raul Ruiz represents California's 25th Congressional District in the U.S. House and is on the ballot for re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ruiz was born in Zacatecas, Mexico, and graduated from Coachella Valley High School in 1990.
Ruiz earned a bachelor's degree from UCLA (1994), a medical degree and a master's in public policy from Harvard University (2001), and a master's in public health from Harvard (2007).
Ruiz worked as a physician and as an associate dean at the University of California, Riverside School of Medicine.
